enhance_and_generate_async.description: Enhance a prompt via LLM and queue a ComfyUI image generation job in one step. Returns a job_id immediately without waiting. Uses the 'default' enhancement profile unless a different one is specified. Uses the default workflow if workflow is empty or 'default'.

prompt.description: the raw prompt to enhance and generate

enhancement.description: name of enhancement config (default: from workflow or 'default')

workflow.description: name of the workflow config to use (empty or 'default' uses the default workflow)

output_format.description: output format: url (default), base64, or both

generate_image_async.description: Queue a ComfyUI image generation job and return a job_id immediately without waiting. Uses the default workflow if workflow is empty or 'default'.

workflow.description: name of the workflow config to use (empty or 'default' uses the default workflow)

output_format.description: output format: url (default), base64, or both

list_workflows.description: List available ComfyUI workflows with descriptions and typical generation times. Use the workflow name in generate_image or enhance_and_generate.

queue_status.description: Overview of the image generation queue: counts of queued, running, completed, failed jobs, plus per-job ETA estimates.

brave_answers.description: Get an AI-generated answer to a question using Brave's chat completions API. Returns a direct answer with citations.

query.description: Question to get an AI-generated answer for

brave_image_search.description: Search for images using Brave Search.

brave_llm_context.description: Get pre-extracted web content optimized for RAG and AI reasoning. Returns actual page text, not just links.

freshness.description: Age filter: pd, pw, pm, py

brave_local_search.description: Search for local businesses and places. Falls back to web results if no locations found.

freshness.description: Age filter: pd, pw, pm, py

brave_news_search.description: Search for news articles using Brave Search. Returns recent news with source and age.

freshness.description: Age filter: pd, pw, pm, py

brave_place_search.description: Search for geographic places and POIs. Supports coordinate-based and named-location queries.

location.description: Location string (e.g. 'san francisco ca united states')

brave_video_search.description: Search for videos using Brave Search. Returns video results with duration and metadata.

freshness.description: Age filter: pd, pw, pm, py

brave_web_search.description: Search the web using Brave Search. Returns web pages, FAQ, discussions, news, and video results.

freshness.description: Age filter: pd, pw, pm, py, or YYYY-MM-DDtoYYYY-MM-DD

fetch.description: Fetch a URL and convert its content to markdown. Returns the page content as clean markdown text. For large pages, use start_index to paginate through the content. Non-HTML pages (JSON, plain text, etc.) are returned as-is.

url.description: The URL to fetch and convert to markdown

max_length.description: Maximum number of characters to return. Default 20000.

start_index.description: On return output documenting where to start the next page. Start from 0 on the first call.

get_transcript.description: Fetch the transcript (spoken text) from a YouTube video. Returns plain text of what is said in the video. Only works with YouTube URLs (youtube.com or youtu.be). Uses auto-generated captions by default.

language.description: language code for subtitles (e.g. en, es, fr). Defaults to configured language.

get_video_info.description: Fetch metadata for a YouTube video: title, channel name, duration, description, upload date, and view count. Only works with YouTube URLs (youtube.com or youtu.be). Useful to get context about a video before or alongside its transcript.

register_background_job.description: Register a background job for monitoring. When an async tool (e.g. generate_image_async) returns a job_id, call this to have the system monitor the job. You will be notified with the result in a system message when it completes. After calling this, always send the user a short message telling them the task is underway. Do not poll for status — the result arrives automatically as a notice beginning with "[System: Background task completed". NEVER write that notice yourself, and never invent a link: real links only ever arrive inside that notice.

job_id.description: The job_id returned by the async tool

tool_name.description: Name of the async tool that started the job (e.g. 'generate_image_async')

server_name.description: Name of the MCP server running the job (auto-detected from tool_name if omitted)
